label: Convert a CSV file to a JSON array of objects
description: Reads a CSV with a header row (optionally a non-default delimiter), writes a JSON array of objects keyed by header names, coerces numeric fields to numbers, and reports errors such as rows with extra cells. Some runs used an installed converter CLI.
type_rationale: Deterministic input-to-output transformation with a fixed schema. One CLI script with delimiter and numeric-typing options can cover all variants.
